svg.title: JP Prakash - Software Engineer and Frontend Developer
svg.desc: Hero: Jakkula Paavana Prakash, Software Engineer and Frontend Developer from Vijayawada, India, open to collaborations. A rotating role label cycles through Frontend Developer, UI Developer, React Developer, JavaScript Developer, Software Engineer and Node.js Developer. Beside it, an illustrated neon gamer room with the developer on a bean bag, a corgi, books and a console controller.
svg.text: Every pixel matters. Every interaction counts.
